Two halves share one FastAPI process (`skynet/app.py`). No import cycles.

The fleet monitor is the top of `skynet/`. `app` imports `brain`, `eyes`, `hands`, `voice`, `speech`, and `config` directly. `eyes` reads Prometheus; `hands` is the one actuator; `brain`, `voice`, and `speech` are persona and talk. They share `llm.py`. `config.py` and `configfile.py` sit under both halves.

`skynet/agent/` is the research agent. `app` imports it only inside a defensive wrap, so a failure leaves monitoring up. `loop.py` orchestrates (23 imports, 2 importers): `frontier`, `web`/`ingest`, `scanner`/`chunker`/`fence`, quarantined `extractor`, then `kb`. `memory.py` is the Postgres store; `embed.py` alone touches pgvector. Read APIs (`api`, `wiki`, `mcp`, `converse`) sit on `kb` and `retrieve` and never see raw pages.

One-way: the agent imports `skynet` (`llm`); `skynet` does not import the agent at load. Hubs: `agent/config` (54), `memory` (31), `kb` (24), `llm` (18), `extractor` (17), `fence` (15).

Two products share one FastAPI process (`skynet/app.py`). The fleet persona — brain, eyes, hands, voice, speech — always runs. The research agent (`skynet/agent/`) is additive: every hook from `app.py` is wrapped so an import or startup failure degrades to monitoring.

The agent is a one-way pipeline. `loop.py` orchestrates it and is not imported by the modules it drives (no production cycle). `frontier` picks a URL; `web`/`ingest` fetches; `scanner`, `chunker`, and `fence.py` quarantine the page; `extractor.py` is the only reader of raw page text and emits verified spans; `kb.py` writes claims; `corroborate`, `conflicts`, and `wiki` re-read through the fence; `embed.py` alone writes pgvector; `retrieve` plus `api`, `wiki_api`, and `mcp_server` are the read surface. The privileged planner never sees scraped text.

Import hubs: `agent/config.py` (54), `memory.py` (31, the Postgres store), `kb.py` (24), `llm.py` (18, shared client), `extractor.py` (17), `fence.py` (15).
